newsitem.title: USA: Vornado Realty Trust prices at $50/shr. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Vornado Realty Trust prices at $50/shr. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects to delete erroneous reference to IPO in headline).
Vornado Realty Trust said Friday it had priced its public offering of five million $3.25 Series A Convertible Preferred Shares at $50 each.
The company said the shares are convertible into common shares at a conversion price of $72.75 each and redeemable after April 1, 2001.

It said it will use the money raised from the offering to fund most of the cash portion of a proposed consolidation with interests held by Mendik Co in seven New York City office buildings, among other things.
Goldman Sachs & Co, Merrill Lynch & Co and UBS Securities are co-managers of the offering.
